about: Martin Luther's Commentary on Galatians (Theodore Graebner's abridged translation) and Lectures on Genesis 1 to 9 (John Nicholas Lenker's two volumes), read by crates/atlas-cli/src/extra_voices/luther.rs from Project Gutenberg ebooks 1549, 48193 and 27978. 'repairs' puts right a letter the copy has wrong; each 'find' is found exactly once in its source. 'places' puts a heading that names a wrong verse on the verse its words are from; each 'heading' starts exactly one heading. 'exclude' lists the passages left out where a note says a word of Scripture, as the BSB prints it, is a mistake, or denies a book its writer (decision 23 of docs/FOUNDER-DECISIONS.md); proposed entries stay until Shubhanshu makes them final.

repairs.why: The heading of Galatians 3:1 prints the digit 0 for the letter O of the King James words "O foolish Galatians".

repairs.find: VERSE 10. l have confidence in you
repairs.to: VERSE 10. I have confidence in you
repairs.why: The heading of Galatians 5:10 prints a small l for the capital I of the King James words "I have confidence in you".

places.heading: V. 2a. And Jehovah said unto Noah, Come thou
places.why: The heading reads "V. 2a." but quotes Genesis 7:1 ("And Jehovah said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark"), and the next heading is "V. 1b."; the section is on 7:1.

exclude.words: Our translation adds that Cain said
exclude.why: Calls Cain's words "Let us go out to the field", which the BSB prints at Genesis 4:8 (its footnote: from the Samaritan Pentateuch, the Septuagint, the Syriac and the Vulgate), an addition of the Latin translation and one of the rabbis' comments. The words left out run to the end of "... I have fully shown on a previous occasion."
exclude.line: A passage is left out here until a decision on it is made.
exclude.proposed: found by the Scripture check of 2026-11-14 (decision 23, rules 3 and 5); for Shubhanshu to make final
